{{Otheruses|Rampart}}
'''''Rampart''''' was a pair of [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|''Assassin''-class corvettes]] that belonged to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. They attempted to reinforce the Rebel platfrom [[RS-32]] an [[XQ2 Platform]] space installation used by the Rebel Alliance, which housed the [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|electromagnetic pulse]] warhead technology that was under attack by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. At least one corvette was destroyed in the battle by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
